nodes.name: Every 10 minutes
nodes.notes: Wakes the machine. If an episode is already being made, the run ends at 'Go?' within a second.

nodes.name: Topics
nodes.notes: EDIT HERE: the topic list and the style of each episode.

nodes.name: Pick next topic
nodes.notes: First topic on the list with no finished episode. Says no if one is in flight or episodes/PAUSE exists.

nodes.name: Nothing to do
nodes.notes: Busy, paused, or the list is finished. See 'why' in the item.

nodes.name: Plan episode
nodes.notes: Opus writes the script, a fact check corrects it, Codex makes the location pictures, each picture is face- and body-checked. About 10-20 minutes.

nodes.name: Shoot episode
nodes.notes: Fish voice, clips on the 5090. Every take: word check, face check, big-mistake picture check; a failed take is reshot up to 4 times. Waits if the 5090 is away. About 20-45 minutes.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Frees the machine for the next topic, refreshes episodes/index.html, files the episode under output/ready_to_post.json or output/needs_look.json.

nodes.name: Upload to YouTube
nodes.notes: Runs on EVERY wake-up (after a finished episode, and also when the machine is busy or idle). Publishes ONE waiting episode from output/ready_to_post.json: the vertical cut as a public Short, then the wide cut as a public video. At least 3 hours between episodes (GAP in scripts/episode_job.py). If an upload fails (sign-in lost, daily upload limit) it waits 2 hours and tries again, so nothing is forgotten. Flagged episodes never get here.

nodes.name: Needs a look
nodes.notes: A take was flagged, or the episode failed. Listed in output/needs_look.json with the reason. Not published. A topic that fails twice is left alone for 3 hours, then tried again.
